response.reason: When a new sequence starts mid-chunk, _local_chunks resets the local state to zero but keeps the cumulative alpha product, and _combine only zeroes that prefix at the exact boundary token; subsequent tokens of the new sequence therefore incorrectly add prefix*carry (carry being the chunk-start state from the previous sequence), which can exceed the 0.002 tolerance. Only boundaries aligned with chunk starts are handled correctly (via _pass_states' factor reset and _combine's previous-token check), so the implementation is wrong for the general packed-sequence domain.
